goal: Develop Xoah posthumous myth across Yasuke and Whitelock timelines
body: 🧬 New Shadow Dweller canon candidate captured as shard 22492@db1. Core mechanism: Xoah's posthumous myth becomes causal infrastructure. Yasuke/Amon is the backward vector: future Martian rift traveler encounters post-Xoah legend, carries fragments/doctrine/symbols back to 1582, and helps preserve the Oda line that eventually produces Xoah, creating a closed myth loop without false lived memory. Whitelock is the forward machine vector: NRK-9 Veilframe with encrypted memory-braid channels inherits Xoah as compressed behavioral doctrine, combat heuristics, archival fragments, or training data, possibly embodying her patterns before learning their origin. Thematic contrast: Yasuke carries Xoah backward as ancestry; Whitelock carries Xoah forward as executable memory. Preserve provenance distinctions between lived memory, learned record, alternate-self memory, and myth. Also captured Dune process-donor prophecy feedback loop as shard 22409@db5. Treat both as proposal/process insight, not canon lock until collision audit.

failures.error: fleet-answer (question-shaped leg): The required next step to execute the final narrative draft is to specify the primary thematic tension between Yasuke's personal sacrifice and Whitelock's political expediency.

resolution: Closed: Yasuke/Whitelock mythos shard integrated into narrative vault.
